# Tool directories

A tool is a directory; `mcphost tool pack <dir>` emits the `host.tool_publish` payload.

| file | holds |
|---|---|
| `tool.toml` | `[tool]` name, kind, description, and `[spec]` (every spec field not kept in its own file) |
| `tool.py` | a python tool's `spec.source` |
| `tool.wasm` | a wasm tool's raw `spec.component` bytes (packed as base64) |
| `tests/<name>.json` | `{args, expect?}` invocations; never part of the payload |

`mcphost tool pack <dir> --as-mcp-call` wraps the payload in a JSON-RPC `tools/call` body for `host.tool_publish`; POST it to a bare `/mcp` with the headers `content-type: application/json`, `MCP-Protocol-Version: 2026-07-28`, `Mcp-Method: tools/call` and `Mcp-Name: host.tool_publish` (implicit signup mints the tenant).

## Publish payload fields

| field | type | required |
|---|---|---|
| `kind` | string | yes |
| `name` | string | yes |
| `scopes` | array | no |
| `spec` | object | yes |
| `tags` | array | no |
| `visibility` | string | no |

Universal spec fields (every kind): `description`, `outputs`, `reads`, `ui`

## Spec fields by kind

| kind | required | file | fields |
|---|---|---|---|
| chain | `steps` | - | `steps` |
| echo | `schema` | - | `schema` |
| http | - | - | `args_schema`, `body`, `description`, `headers`, `method`, `query`, `response`, `timeout_s`, `upstream`, `upstream_provider`, `url` |
| jq | `program` | - | `args_schema`, `description`, `max_output_bytes`, `outputs`, `program`, `timeout_s` |
| js | `source` | - | `args_schema`, `description`, `env`, `memory_mb`, `network`, `outputs`, `secrets`, `source`, `timeout_s` |
| python | `source` | `tool.py` = `source` | `args_schema`, `description`, `env`, `memory_mb`, `network`, `requirements`, `secrets`, `source`, `timeout_s` |
| wasm | `component` | `tool.wasm` = `component` | `args_schema`, `component`, `memory_mb`, `timeout_s` |
